title: The math was optional
brief: The crowd approaches green +6 and red negative gates, goes right through -5, and visibly drops from 10 to 5. It then runs toward a green +4 gate, takes it, and recovers to 9. The recovery is partial, not a win. Make an ironic confident-setup/fail/recovery edit. Keep both gate contacts, labels, and the top-center crowd counter legible. Avoid covering the runners in the lower-middle. The source is already 720x1280 portrait and silent.
